C reaches the helper and its visible-nymph message forces a --More-- boundary; JavaScript records note_unported("music.c calm_nymphs") and advances directly to exercise and the monster turn. source.branch: In do_improvisation()’s WOODEN_HARP arm, when rn2(ACURR(A_DEX)) + u.ulevel > 25, C calls calm_nymphs(u.ulevel * 3) before exercise(A_DEX, TRUE). calm_nymphs() scans fmon in order, skipping DEADMONSTER entries; for each S_NYMPH with mcanmove and mdistu(mtmp) < distance, it clears msleeping, sets mpeaceful, clears mavenge and STRAT_WAITMASK, then calls pline(Monnam(...)) only when canseemon() is true. The helper has no RNG draw and does not thaw a monster whose mcanmove is false.
callers: C production chain: apply.c:doapply() dispatches musical instruments to do_play_instrument() (:4373-4383); music.c:do_play_instrument() routes the accepted improvisation answer to do_improvisation() (:783-784); its WOODEN_HARP arm calls calm_nymphs() only after the special-effect gate (:672-686). calm_nymphs() has this single source call site (besides its declaration).

JavaScript production chain is already present: js/apply.js:doapply() routes WOODEN_HARP to do_play_instrument() (:5008-5019); js/music.js:do_play_instrument() dispatches the accepted improvisation to do_improvisation(); the matching WOODEN_HARP arm currently replaces the C helper with note_unported("music.c calm_nymphs") at :271-279. Wire the whole helper there before exercise; apply.js and do_play_instrument() need no separate change for this case.
dependencies: C fmon maps to state.level.monlist; DEADMONSTER(mon) is mon.mhp < 1 (include/monst.h:213-214); S_NYMPH maps to the exported JavaScript monster-class constant. Keep the source loop order and skip dead entries.

mdistu(mon) expands to distu(mon.mx, mon.my), then dist2 against the hero (include/hack.h:1531-1532); js/hacklib.js:dist2() already supplies this calculation. Preserve the strict < comparison against the caller-provided distance.

The selected mutations map directly to existing monster fields. The visible branch uses canseemon(), Monnam(), and pline(); js/music.js already imports canseemon, Monnam and ttyPline and passes the caller’s message callback through env. No unported callee result is consumed; the helper itself has no RNG or return-valued dependency.
